brief_problem: The card with a negative balance

runs.text: A well-made object does not let anyone put it in a state that makes no sense.
that anyone can change from outside. A program charged
How is the card written so that this cannot happen, whoever uses it?
Write in one sentence what always has to be true of a canteen card.
The balance is never negative. Also, loading and charging only make sense with positive amounts.

entries.text: What goes in and what comes out?
Requests to charge and to load go in; whether it worked, and the balance, come out.
, but now they live inside the object.
Who has the information to do this?
The card: it knows its balance, so it is the only one that can decide whether a charge is enough.

blocks.description: A safe with the balance inside, private. Outside, three windows: Cobrar and Cargar, which decide whether the request gets in, and Saldo, which lets you see the value without touching it.

caption.text: The attributes stay inside; the methods are windows that decide what goes in and what comes out.

runs.text: Visibility decides what can be used from outside: what is public is a commitment, what is private can change.

blocks.title: The card that looks after itself

runs.text: The charge of 50 is rejected and changes nothing; so is the load of -100. The charge of exactly 30 is accepted and leaves the balance at 0, which still meets the invariant.

rows.text: an amount that is not positive

runs.text: The card keeps its balance private and only changes it with charges and loads that keep the balance free of negatives
Compare it with the public attribute version: there the rule had to be repeated in every program that used the card, and one that forgot it was enough. Now it lives in a single place.

points.text: Encapsulating is hiding the attributes and letting only the methods change them.
A class invariant is what has to be true of every object before and after each method.

title.text: What is always true of a lift

entries.text: It is so that nobody can break the invariant from outside.
Checking outside instead of in the method.
It works until someone uses the card from another program.
A public method to set each attribute.
With a method that sets any balance, the protection disappears.
